items.title: Generally Available: Azure Front Door TLS key exchange policy with post-quantum support
items.description:
Azure Front Door now supports configurable TLS key exchange policies, including hybrid post-quantum key exchange, to help you prepare for evolving cryptographic threats while meeting your security and client compatibility requirements. Choose a predefined Standard or Enhanced policy, or use a Custom policy to select supported classical and hybrid post-quantum key exchange groups, including the option to select X25519. Hybrid post-quantum key exchange requires TLS 1.3 and protects client-to-edge connections; it does not apply to connections from Azure Front Door to your origin. 

For additional control over TLS encryption, Azure Front Door also supports disabling the  TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256  cipher suite when TLS 1.3 is configured as the minimum TLS version in TLS Policy. Together, these updates give you more flexibility to tailor key exchange and cipher suite settings to your application’s security requirements.

Learn more.

items.title: Generally Available: WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway
items.description:
WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway Web Application Firewall (WAF) is now generally available. WAF Insights is a built-in experience in the WAF policy that brings WAF logs and metrics together in interactive dashboards, so you can investigate blocked requests, analyze attack patterns, and identify false positives without writing queries.

With general availability, WAF Insights supports both Azure Diagnostics and resource-specific logs, renames the Triage tab to Investigate, and counts each request once by its final WAF outcome. Use the Monitor tab to track WAF activity and the most active rules, and the Investigate tab to drill down from a rule or a URL to the exact request and every rule it matched.

Learn more.
